description: This file defines an interface 'JsonValueContainer' that represents a generic container for JSON values, providing methods to check if it's empty, get its size, and stream its contents.

classes.name: JsonValueContainer
classes.description: A generic interface representing a container that holds JSON values, supporting iteration and providing methods for size and emptiness checks.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the container is empty, returning true if it contains no values.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of values contained in the container.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of the JSON values contained in the container.
